doc: The seeds file of M3's typed-sorts sidecar (holon-sort-seeds/0.2; holon.sorts.extracted, rule E3), written for the blind rerun from code alone. Seeds are the only target vocabulary of the sorts pass: which terms, digests and storage families carry which sort. The target code at the pinned commit fixes no such vocabulary (a sort such as Idx[k] or Dig[kind] is a reading of the code, not a fact of it), so this file declares no term, digest or lexical seed and no writer-label rule: every sort comes from the documents' types and flows, and an unlabelled writer set takes the documented fallback label.
